lines.say: Every pull you log is full of answers.
E-S-O Logs records all of it. Every hit, every heal, every buff.
E-S-O Toolkit reads that same log, and shows you what it means. Just paste the link.
Here's one tank's gear in E-S-O Logs. Thirteen items, one per row. E-S-O Toolkit groups them into sets, lays out both skill bars the way they look in game, and checks the build for common mistakes.
That scribed skill? E-S-O Toolkit works out its focus, signature and affix scripts from the fight itself.
E-S-O Logs replays a fight from above. E-S-O Toolkit rebuilds it in 3D. Orbit the arena, follow any player, and rewatch the moment that mattered.
Found a build worth copying? Send it to the Build Editor. Or start from what top players run. The Build Leaderboard sorts top-ranked parses into the builds behind them, by class and by boss.
Then check the math. Plan a scribed skill script by script, and work out your penetration and crit in the calculators.

Leading a trial? The Roster Builder plans the whole group. Tanks, healers and damage dealers, their sets and ultimates, even builds for each fight. Share it as a link, publish it to Roster Hub, or post it to Discord, where the roster bot takes sign-ups.
And for your addons, there's Kalpa. A free addon manager that installs and updates them in one click, pulls in the libraries they need, and installs whole community packs from Pack Hub.
E-S-O Logs records the fight. E-S-O Toolkit helps you understand it, and get ready for the next one. Free, at E-S-O-T-K dot com.
